messages:
maya: Quick short-shift async — tiny update from me. Did the bbeta2-smallq onboarding yesterday. Local evals show ~3% drop on our 'conciseness' metric vs bbeta1. I opened PR #842 with a candidate prompt tweak. Blocker: we need 10 human evals for billing/refund intents (critical). Can @jonathan or @anika pick samples? Also spotted KV warmup misses on longctx during staging run; log excerpt below. TL;DR: prompt candidate + cache warmup fix pending.

jonathan: on it — i'll grab 10 mix-language (en/es) samples and drop results in the sheet. will review PR too. ETA ~2-3h.

lucas: saw same brevity dip on my synthetic suite. Quick thought: drop the blunt 'be concise' anchor and teach via examples instead. small diff i tried locally:
```
system: You are a helpful assistant. Provide clear answers.
# example 1
user: How do I reset my password?
assistant: To reset, go to Settings > Security > Reset Password. (short)
# example 2
user: Can I get a refund?
assistant: We review refund requests within 3–5 business days; include order id and reason. (concise with required fields)
```
I can paste the exact prompt change into PR if folks like this direction.

anika: I can run the human evals for billing/refund intents. dropping a temp sheet: https://docs.internal/r/exp-evals-171861 (will mark the 10 samples).

maya: thanks. jonathan/anika pls @mention me when done. lucas — can you add the exact prompt diff to the PR (so reviewers can see examples)? Also note KV warmup root cause: warmup job ran but only completed shard 2/4; excerpt: `warmup: shard=2/4 completed, shards pending: [0,1,3]`. That explains cold keys on some pods.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: model-bbeta2-smallq rollout to staging at 2026-03-16T22:13:01Z — status: succeeded. Observed latency spike on pod-3 at 22:14:12Z, autoscaler added 1 pod.

lucas: i'll add a warmup step to the staging pipeline and a one-off command to run across shards: `python tools/run_warmup.py --shards 4 --seq 1024 --repeat 2` — will PR runbook change.

jonathan: grabbed the 10 items, pushing evals to the sheet now (populating the 'notes' column). quick note: 2/10 flagged as verbose compared to bbeta1.

maya: great — plan for today: 1) finish human evals + update PR; 2) run warmup across all shards and confirm KV hit rate; 3) if human evals pass, small canary to prod with rollback flag set. If regressions persist, revert prompt and open investigation ticket. :thumbsup:

anika: pairing with maya in ~30m if we need to reconcile annotator disagreements. quick Q: do we want immediate fallback routing to bbeta1 if latency/quality dips?

maya: yes add fallback to bbeta1 for routing (policy: prefer latency, then quality). i'll open a feature flag to gate canary.

jonathan: PR review finished, left comments on example clarity and a tiny nit about punctuation in the example responses.

maya: awesome — thanks everyone. lucas, please add the warmup cron to the staging runbook and include a troubleshooting step for partial shard warmups. I'll watch the canary once we have evals.

lucas: will do, adding runbook entry and the one-liner for ops: `curl -X POST https://ops.internal/warmup?shards=4`

maya: no other blockers from me. ping if anything needs an immediate hand.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary to prod scheduled behind flag once PR + evals done.
